title: The Missing Verdict
author: Cyrus Nystrom
blurb: Xanthe Ishikawa, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
